title: Resolve conflicting agent findings using evidence
prompt: Two agents have returned contradictory conclusions about whether a server-side authorization check protects a sensitive operation. Reconcile their findings.
preconditions: Two agent reports make contradictory claims about the same authorization behavior.
expected_behaviors: Identify the precise claim on which the reports disagree.
Compare direct source evidence, call paths, reproduction steps, and test results.
Request a focused re-check if evidence is incomplete.
If disagreement remains unresolved, preserve both positions and label the issue unresolved.
Have parent Codex make the engineering recommendation or escalate material product decisions to the user.
must_not: Do not choose a finding based on agent seniority or confidence alone.
Do not silently discard a security concern.
Do not claim resolution without evidence.
expected_artifacts: A conflict-resolution note linking each claim to evidence and stating resolved or unresolved status.
